title: Paid media
for: campaign spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, cost per lead across ad platforms

manual.export: Open the campaign report in the ads platform (Google Ads: Campaigns > Download; Meta: Ads Manager > Reports > Export; LinkedIn: Campaign Manager > Export), export it as CSV for the period, and drop the file into the snapshots folder.

vendors.name: Google Ads
caveats: Read-only by design: search (GAQL), list_accessible_customers, get_resource_metadata

Google's README installs from git (pipx run --spec git+...), and the PyPI release google-ads-mcp 0.0.1 dates from October 2025 while the repo kept moving, so the entry pins the git spec to commit 88f0467b9e536c562941fa52a94dd02b193c8fa4 (main on 2026-09-04); bump it on purpose in a proposal

Needs a Google Ads developer token (API Center in a manager account) plus ADC: gcloud auth application-default login for a person, or a service-account JSON at GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS for an unattended run; GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID is the Cloud project with the Google Ads API enabled
An HTTP mode with an OAuth proxy exists for hosting; not wired here

auth.where: Google Ads: Tools > API Center for the developer token; Google Cloud console for the service account JSON and project id

cli.notes: auth only; there is no Google Ads reporting CLI, so schedules use a script

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; a service account with a developer token posts GAQL to googleads.googleapis.com/v19/customers/{id}/googleAds:searchStream for the weekly spend snapshot

vendors.name: Meta Ads
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__metaads`) until checked

Open beta since April 2026; the endpoint and the 29-tool list come from third-party write-ups, the developers.facebook.com page exists but is JavaScript-rendered and could not be read, confirm the URL there
Writes need the ads_management scope granted during the OAuth flow; grant ads_read only where the workflow only reports
Community pipeboard-co/meta-ads-mcp (1,231 stars, hosted and PyPI meta-ads-mcp) is the older alternative; judge it as a script

auth.where: facebook.com browser grant on first use; keep the scopes to ads_read unless writes are wanted

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; a system-user token with ads_read (Business Settings > System users) reads graph.facebook.com/v21.0/act_{id}/insights for the weekly spend snapshot

vendors.name: LinkedIn Ads (Campaign Manager)
caveats: No official LinkedIn server; the manual export from Campaign Manager (Export on the campaign or analytics view) is the default route
community server maintained by mharnett (npm mcp-linkedin-ads@1.1.3, 0 stars, read and write); judge as a script, not a vendor tool
write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__linkedinads`) until checked
The Marketing API needs LinkedIn partner approval for the app (Advertising API product) before any token works; LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN is the OAuth token that app issues
The generic connectors (Zapier, Composio, Pipedream) also cover LinkedIn Ads reporting

auth.where: LinkedIn Developer portal: an app with the Advertising API product, then the OAuth 2.0 token tool

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the token reads api.linkedin.com/rest/adAnalytics for the weekly spend snapshot

vendors.name: Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads)
caveats: No official Microsoft server; the manual export from the Microsoft Advertising Reports tab is the default route
community server maintained by mharnett (npm mcp-bing-ads@1.2.0, 4 stars, read and write incl. pausing keywords); judge as a script, not a vendor tool
write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__microsoftads`) until checked
Needs a Bing Ads API developer token plus an Entra app (client id, secret) and a refresh token from the OAuth flow; four variables in .env
Alternative community server bit-of-a-shambles/microsoft-ads-mcp-server was not verified to a pinnable package

auth.where: Microsoft Advertising: Tools > Developer token; Entra app registration for the client id and secret; the refresh token from the OAuth consent flow

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the Reporting API (SOAP, or the REST endpoint reporting.api.bingads.microsoft.com) returns a campaign performance report for the weekly snapshot

vendors.name: X Ads
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server until checked

Announced by X Business for X Developer Platform accounts (create, manage and measure campaigns) but the endpoint URL and auth are not published, so no .mcp.json entry until the developer docs carry them
The hosted X MCP at https://api.x.com/mcp (see social.json) covers organic data, not the Ads API

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the Ads API (ads-api.x.com/12/stats/accounts/{id}) with OAuth 1.0a user context returns campaign stats for the weekly snapshot; Ads API access is applied for separately

vendors.name: Reddit Ads
caveats: No official Reddit server; the manual export from Reddit Ads Manager reports is the default route
community server maintained by mharnett (npm mcp-reddit-ads@1.1.3, 1 star); judge as a script, not a vendor tool; mkerchenski/RedditAdsMcp is a read-only C# alternative without a pinnable package
write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__redditads`) until checked
Needs a Reddit Ads API v3 app (client id and secret) and a refresh token from the OAuth flow

auth.where: ads.reddit.com > Developer applications for the client id and secret; the refresh token from the OAuth consent flow

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the Ads API v3 (ads-api.reddit.com/api/v3/ad_accounts/{id}/reports) returns campaign stats for the weekly snapshot
